    instance ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.CEP.Faithful.instRealComplexScalarTowerCStarAlgebra (A : Type u_1) [CStarAlgebra A] :
    IsScalarTower ℝ ℂ A

    The ℝ-ℂ scalar tower on any C*-algebra A, needed by the generalized C*-coefficient functoriality (CorrBimod A H). IsScalarTower is a Prop class, so this global instance is diamond-safe. Covers End H/End L and Fin m → ℂ (all C*-algebras) uniformly, so the tower need not be an explicit hypothesis on the functoriality nor synthesized ad hoc downstream.

        structure ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.CEP.Faithful.CorrBimod (A : Type u) (H : Type v) [Semiring A] [Star A] [Algebra ℂ A] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] :
        Type (max (max u v) (w + 1))

        Common bimodule base for the interior-tensor engine: a right Hilbert C*-module over (End H)ᵐᵒᵖ together with a left action of an arbitrary ℂ-⋆-algebra A by adjointable right-module maps. CorrEndBimod L H is the special case A = End L; CorrToEnd A H is the general case. The engine (form / PSD / completion / ℓ²-distribution) is factored over this single structure, so it serves both left algebras with no forgetful coercion.

        • carrier : Type w
        • instNAG : NormedAddCommGroup self.carrier
        • instNS : NormedSpace ℂ self.carrier
        • rightSMul : SMul (End H)ᵐᵒᵖ self.carrier
        • rightCStar : CStarModule (End H)ᵐᵒᵖ self.carrier
        • leftAct : A → self.carrier →L[ℂ] self.carrier
        • left_add (a b : A) (e : self.carrier) : (self.leftAct (a + b)) e = (self.leftAct a) e + (self.leftAct b) e
        • left_smul (c : ℂ) (a : A) (e : self.carrier) : (self.leftAct (c • a)) e = c • (self.leftAct a) e
        • left_one (e : self.carrier) : (self.leftAct 1) e = e
        • left_mul (a b : A) (e : self.carrier) : (self.leftAct (a * b)) e = (self.leftAct a) ((self.leftAct b) e)
